text: Police destroy your home chasing a stranger who broke in at random. You did nothing wrong. What you are owed depends on your city.
provenance: Nobody gets to choose which door the emergency comes through.
Nobody in this story did the wrong thing that day.

text: Indiana, 2022. Police had a warrant, an internet address and the wrong home. Thirty canisters of tear gas went in. Nobody paid for it.
provenance: They had a warrant, an IP address, and the wrong home.
Thirty canisters of tear gas had already gone in through the broken windows.
The damage came to about sixteen thousand dollars, and the city and the county each refused to pay it.

text: Texas. A federal jury said one woman was owed nearly sixty thousand dollars. A federal appeals court erased it. Nobody disputes the police acted lawfully.
provenance: A federal jury said she was owed nearly sixty thousand dollars, and the Fifth Circuit erased it
Nobody disputes the police acted lawfully.

text: Then Las Vegas. The department denied the claim, then reversed itself after the story ran. Same damage, and the difference was not a rule. It was a news cycle.
provenance: The department denied the claim, and then, after the story ran, reversed itself and covered it. Same kind of emergency, same kind of damage, and the difference was not a rule. It was a news cycle.

text: Tennessee. Deputies put about thirty-five gas canisters into a house. Roughly seventy thousand dollars of damage.
provenance: Deputies came for the Slaybaughs' son, who was staying with them, and put about thirty-five gas canisters into the house.

text: Los Angeles. A fugitive locked a man out of his print shop. In 2025 a court ruled he gets nothing.
provenance: In November 2025 the Ninth Circuit ruled that Carlos Pena gets nothing.
Thirteen hours earlier, in August 2022, an armed fugitive had shoved Pena out of his own print shop in Los Angeles and locked the door behind him.

text: Whether you are made whole is not decided by the Constitution. It is decided by which city you live in. And nobody chooses which door the emergency comes through.
provenance: Whether you are made whole is not decided by the Constitution. It's decided by which city you happen to live in.
